# `tools/inspector/panels/spawner/EmitterInspectorCard.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/inspector/panels/spawner/EmitterInspectorCard.js`

EmitterInspectorCard.js - Shared emitter property card component Modular emitter editor used by both Spawner and Entities inspector panels. Configurable sections: header, elements, physics, aim.

## Functions

### `createEmitterInspectorCard(doc, options = {})`

Create a modular emitter inspector card.

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — The document to create elements in
- `options` *(Object)* — Configuration options
- `options.emitterCfg` *(Object)* — Emitter config object with properties to edit
- `[options.props]` *(Object)* — Optional spawner props for color sync (has .color array)
- `[options.sections]` *(Object)* — Which sections to show (default all true)
- `[options.sections.header` *(boolean)* — =true] - Show state badge + color preview
- `[options.sections.elements` *(boolean)* — =true] - Show element toggles with power sliders
- `[options.sections.physics` *(boolean)* — =true] - Show physics property grid
- `[options.sections.aim` *(boolean)* — =false] - Show aim controls (requires setGhostOffset)
- `[options.setGhostOffset]` *(Function)* — Ghost offset setter for aim controls
- `[options.onColorChange]` *(Function)* — Callback when derived color changes

**Returns:** }
